forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 18 of April, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Work included 1 zone survey, 3 visits and 1 clearance; no technical surveys were completed. So far, 14 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, 6 areas released and 3 cleared.

No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No reports were held or queried, and no dossiers were held. The access feed shows 8 zones closed. No new plan was approved; the plan remains P04.

The forecast, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is already done, gives a range of 9–14 mine areas cleared and 9–13 zones declared free this season.
